description: This file defines a custom autograd Function for per-sample gradient computation of Group Normalization in PyTorch, including forward and backward passes, utilizing expanded weights and utilities.

classes.name: GroupNormPerSampleGrad
classes.description: Custom autograd Function for group normalization with per-sample gradient support.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of group normalization, computing output, mean, and rstd.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Computes the backward pass, calculating gradients with respect to input, weight, and bias.
